ns2:section.sectionText: Lab hours include assisting in preschool classroom 4 hours per week, including lesson planning and implementation, guidance practice, and guided experience with portfolio informal assessment tool. There will be an individual meeting set up with lab instructor one classes start. Registration by non-HDFS majors requires instructor permission. Contact Dr. Brent McBride at brentmcb@illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Human Development & Family St major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
